# Bihar — local body reservation

*Generated by `make state-readmes`. Edits here are overwritten — change the data or the generator instead.*

**The parsed data for Bihar is in [local_elections_bihar](https://github.com/in-rolls/local_elections_bihar)** — gp_head, gp_ward, block_member, zp_member, kachahari, 2016. It was split into its own repository, so it is counted in the [top-level readme](../../readme.md) but has no rows here.

What is in this directory is source material: 406 files, 290 digital-text, 105 tabular, 11 other, 9,193 pages.

It is not in this repository's schema, so it does not appear in the per-slice table. Bringing a sibling to that grain means giving its parsed files the shared columns — `state`, `year`, `tier`, `caste_reservation`, `woman_reserved` — which is the schema harmonisation still to be done.
